references.text: The same ritual of dipping the finger in oil and sprinkling it seven times before the Lord, which is the basis for this verse
The priest shall sprinkle blood seven times before the Lord, before the veil to the sanctuary - the same sprinkling pattern
The priest dips his finger in the blood and sprinkles it seven times before the Lord - a parallel ritual with seven sprinklings
Moses sprinkled the anointing oil seven times on the altar - the same pattern of seven sprinklings
Sprinkling seven times in the cleansing ritual for a house with leprosy - the same sprinkling action
The priest shall dip his finger in blood and sprinkle it seven times toward the tent sanctuary - a parallel ritual
Use of anointing oil on Aaron's head - oil used in priestly consecration as in the cleansing ritual
